text: AI is making your next phone more expensive.
Do you know why your next phone or laptop might cost way more?
Every phone and laptop needs memory chips. RAM.
But AI data centers are buying those chips first... and paying way more for them.
So the big chipmakers are moving their factories to AI.
The result? Memory prices roughly doubled.
Phone prices jumped about twenty-five to thirty percent in a year.
Laptop makers raised prices up to twenty percent.
And phones under two hundred dollars? They're disappearing from shelves.
Some brands even plan to put used, recycled memory into cheap phones.
One of the biggest chipmakers just said the next two years will be even tighter.
Prices could keep climbing until mid twenty twenty-eight.
So if you need a new phone or laptop... waiting might cost you more.
Would you buy now, or wait?
